description: This file defines a PHP class 'BuzzModuleStatusChangeSubscriber' that subscribes to module status change events within the OrangeHRM system. It handles changes related to the 'buzz' module, updating permissions accordingly.

classes.name: BuzzModuleStatusChangeSubscriber
classes.description: A subscriber class that listens for module status change events, specifically for the 'buzz' module, and updates permissions accordingly.

methods.name: getSubscribedEvents
methods.description: Returns an array mapping the module status change event to the handler method 'onStatusChangeEvent'.

methods.name: onStatusChangeEvent
methods.description: Handles the module status change event; if the 'buzz' module has just been deactivated, updates the widget permissions.
